scope: Full in-game UI composition proposals; static only, unapproved

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE complete 16:9 IN-GAME screenshot concept for an original PC turn-based occult strategy game, Chinese title 邪神苏醒. This is a full game UI visual-direction sample, not a website, presentation, art board, infographic, wireframe, or decorative illustration. Input image 1 (Endless Legend) is REFERENCE ONLY for how the playable scene, local selection, small edge HUD and turn control coexist. Input image 2 (Book of Hours) is REFERENCE ONLY for how an inhabited environment and object-specific operations share an authored visual language. Do not copy either game's architecture, map, characters, icons, logos, screenshots or world setting.

PRIMARY DESIGN: a continuous perceived-world scene, where the scene itself carries the relevant objects and the interface grows locally from selection. View a mortal council archive/civic institution obliquely from above as a discrete slice of reality surrounded by quiet unformed space, no shared geographical world map and no territory gameplay. The institution is alive with a few small groups of people, light from real work areas, distinct archives and a small assembly space; no giant person or character portrait. Selected institution is the concrete anchor target, identifiable through a precise restrained in-scene selection marker. The world remains the dominant playable-looking spatial surface rather than a rectangular background illustration.

SAME GAME CONTENT TO PRESERVE: current world 镜证议会, current task 锚定准备, dependencies 护持者 / 圣物 / 供奉 / 材料, a compact set of guardian candidate seals near the selected target, selected relic 见证透镜, global access to 诸界 / 权能 / 圣物 / 收支 / 苏醒 / 历史, and 返回 / 确认 actions. Task and current selection have distinct identities. Related information is a modest local unfolding insert next to the selected object, not a huge right-hand text rectangle. Arrange the dependencies as actual native-game object receptacles and status marks connected to the selected target; do not add card combination, drag-placement, building, movement or ritual rules. Candidate seals are an interface idiom, not actual summoned people. Costs and state labels can be short, no invented outcome, no long prose. UI labels should be readable, professionally typeset Simplified Chinese, few well-chosen labels rather than explanatory paragraphs.

UI ART: mature tactile game interface with edited silhouettes, custom resource glyphs, weight and pressed/selected affordances, layered partial supports, restrained frosted obsidian and worn silver detailing, clean bone-white type, selective small warm cues. Every edge, field of contrast, icon and selected state should belong to one original game visual system. Landscape objects, indicators, local options and quiet HUD form one screen, with environmental depth, occlusion and intentionally clear reading zones. Not merely a nice picture with a strip of web controls pasted on. No full-width website header; no article heading; no equal card grid; no top tab navigation; no breadcrumb bar; no uniform HTML buttons; no universal giant opaque panel; no generic gold fantasy frame; no portraits; no propaganda posters; no worker heroic pose; no Soviet or Cultural Revolution motifs. No visible god, no giant tentacles, no icy Frostpunk city or hex map. No browser or desktop chrome, no concept-art page margins. Frame edge-to-edge as a credible paused playable strategy game with real UI, polished enough for art-direction judgment.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE complete 16:9 IN-GAME screenshot concept for the same original PC turn-based occult strategy game 邪神苏醒. Deliver a credible game screen, not website, slideshow, diagram, concept-art poster or a conventional character-plus-info-panel collage. Input image 1 (Book of Hours) is REFERENCE ONLY for persistent object identity, a material scene, and operations focused on particular objects. Input image 2 (Endless Legend) is REFERENCE ONLY for restrained HUD occupying edges while the interactive field stays primary. Do not copy source images, characters, assets, icons, typography or specific UI geometry.

PRIMARY DESIGN, A DIFFERENT SPATIAL ANSWER: make the central god-side perception interface itself an authored, tactile game interaction surface. Instead of depicting one continuous geographic city, three disconnected glimpses of contacted mortal institutions appear at different depths within a quiet dark, spacious threshold. They are framed by irregular planes of pale mineral, ink-like shadow and dark glass with a restrained luminous edge. These glimpses are interface manifestations of known contacts, not a map of connected places. The selected institution becomes a larger central focus. Clearly identifiable little object effigies/seals for a guardian, a relic and an offering surround that focus at useful reading distances; only meaningful dependency paths join them. These are functional objects with visible selection and state, not an astrology chart, node editor, flowchart or decorative magical circle. The viewpoint is the unseen god arranging its attention, not a person sitting at a human desk or altar.

EXACT SAME CONTENT AS THE OTHER DIRECTION: world 镜证议会, main task 锚定准备, dependencies 护持者 / 圣物 / 供奉 / 材料, guardian candidate seals in one compact local selector, selected relic 见证透镜, global access to 诸界 / 权能 / 圣物 / 收支 / 苏醒 / 历史, and 返回 / 确认. Keep task identity separate from briefly inspected object identity. A small unfurled attached label displays the inspected relic and its relevance while the selected institution and preparation stay visible. Preserve known task/navigation relationships; no new card recipes, slot bonuses, travel, mana systems or outcomes. Short readable Simplified Chinese UI, professional letterforms; no long prose blocks or fake lorem ipsum. No arbitrary gameplay numbers.

UI ART: a unified original game UI built from expressive object silhouettes, quiet title typography, fine but legible pictographic marks, layered opaque and translucent material only where reading needs it, selected/empty/unavailable states that differ in shape. Soft ivory mineral and charcoal ink with localized muted amber and blue-grey accents; avoid red/green propaganda palette. Space, material, typography, interaction hierarchy and local feedback should create an unmistakable playable game interface without relying on a character portrait or a background painting. Crisp enough to read, intriguing without masses of glowing runes. Edges and negative spaces should vary with object roles. Avoid the universal top-header/left-menu/right-panel/footer-toolbar pattern. No website header, top tabs, breadcrumb bar, equal card grid, tables, generic rectangular HTML buttons, large opaque text panel, infographic connectors, giant portraits, real-world propaganda, heroic workers, Soviet or Cultural Revolution motifs. No visible god, no giant tentacles, no illustrated hero. No desktop/browser chrome or outer presentation margins. Full-screen paused gameplay concept with bespoke interface and composed environmental depth.

ui_only_revision.prompt:
Edit this in-game UI concept. Preserve the entire original archive environment, camera, small people, current world name 镜证议会, full-screen composition, selected institution and existing top-right global access. Change ONLY the visual organization of the UI and its object bindings:
REMOVE the large central opaque gold-bordered information panel entirely; reveal the scene behind it. Replace it with a compact local anchor preparation interface attached just below the selected institution: a short horizontal group of four individually legible native-game object indicators labelled 护持者, 圣物, 供奉, 材料, each with a small readable state mark, and a small nearby row of guardian candidate seals. Do not place these in a new large rectangular enclosing panel. Show the inspected 见证透镜 as a small attached tooltip near its scene object, clearly secondary to the anchor target. Title 锚定准备 should be a local title near the actual target, not a large centered header. Give labels a quiet translucent support only as needed. Reduce shiny gold outlining across the UI; retain thin worn-silver/soft-ivory edge accents and a restrained selection highlight. A selected object and UI must feel responsive and clickable, but the environment must remain the actual primary interaction field, not art behind a dashboard.
Replace the invented four-resource numeric HUD at top left with exactly three small custom glyphs and labels only: 低语, 信仰, 苏醒. No numeric values anywhere. Keep other global labels 诸界, 权能, 圣物, 收支, 苏醒, 历史. Retain 返回 and 确认 at the screen edges at small game-HUD scale, not as website buttons. Do not add new rules, new characters, giant portraits, any extra windows, a generic opaque text panel, paragraph prose, a card grid or a breadcrumb bar. The single objective is a more scene-integrated functional UI, not a different background illustration.
